review:
Sweet Bonanza is the candy slot that invented pay-anywhere tumbles, years before Gates of Olympus made them everywhere – and it still plays great. Bright and cheerful on the surface, but most real potential lives in the free spins, where the bomb multipliers land.

Unlike Gates, those multipliers don't carry over through the bonus – each tumble sequence stands on its own, which makes individual spins more exciting and the round less predictable. A 21,175x max, way above the original Gates, with high volatility and a 96.48% RTP. Play the demo free before you settle into a session; Pragmatic Play's original is still the one worth knowing.
pros: High max win for its age
Bombs in every free spin keep the bonus lively
cons: Multipliers do not persist between spins
Base game rarely produces meaningful wins
